description: Where the execution state sits on each wire, for each placement, in the first and second requests of the recorded scenario (the scripted model, the recorded runtime): on the first request a second text part of the person's own message on every wire; on the second a user message after the history (trailing-user) or the end of the system text (system-tail; one string with the system head on the OpenAI-compatible wire, a block or part after it on the other two). This harness's (agent#9), not yet the Desk's.

files: packages/harness/engines/vercel/prefix.test.ts (the run each item is checked against), in this repository
